#!/bin/bash
# Monitor de audio - garante ALC892 funcional e respeita sink do usuario
log() { logger "[audio-watch] $1"; echo "$1"; }
LAST_S3=0
FLAG_FILE="/tmp/.audio-watch-boot-done"

boot_set_default() {
    [ -f "$FLAG_FILE" ] && return
    touch "$FLAG_FILE"
    log "boot: verificando fone Bluetooth..."
    for i in $(seq 1 20); do
        SINK=$(pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -i "bluez" | awk "{print \$2}" | head -1)
        if [ -n "$SINK" ]; then
            pactl set-default-sink "$SINK" 2>/dev/null
            log "boot: fone BT definido como padrao: $SINK"
            return
        fi
        sleep 1
    done
    log "boot: fone BT nao encontrado"
}

fix_alsa_mixer() {
    sudo amixer -c 0 set "Auto-Mute Mode" Disabled 2>/dev/null
    sudo amixer -c 0 set "Master" 100% 2>/dev/null
    sudo amixer -c 0 set "Front" 100% unmute 2>/dev/null
}

recover_module() {
    log "nivel 1: rescan + modprobe..."
    sudo /usr/local/bin/pci-rescan.sh 2>/dev/null
    sleep 2
    modprobe -r snd_hda_intel snd_hda_codec 2>/dev/null
    sleep 3
    modprobe snd_hda_intel single_cmd=1 enable_msi=0 2>&1
    sleep 5
    aplay -l 2>/dev/null | grep -q "card" && return 0
    return 1
}

recover_s3_reset() {
    now=$(date +%s)
    [ $((now - LAST_S3)) -lt 300 ] && return 1
    log "nivel 2: S3 suspend (reset hw)..."
    LAST_S3=$now
    sudo rtcwake -m mem -s 10 2>&1
    sleep 15
    modprobe -r snd_hda_intel snd_hda_codec 2>/dev/null
    sleep 3
    modprobe snd_hda_intel single_cmd=1 enable_msi=0 2>&1
    sleep 5
    aplay -l 2>/dev/null | grep -q "card" && return 0
    return 1
}

has_alc892() { pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "pci-0000_00_1b.0\|ALC892"; }
has_autonull() { pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "auto_null"; }

unmute_if_needed() {
    local SINK
    SINK=$(pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "pci-0000_00_1b.0|ALC892" | awk "{print \$2}" | head -1)
    [ -z "$SINK" ] && return 1
    MUTE=$(pactl get-sink-mute "$SINK" 2>/dev/null | grep -o yes)
    VOL=$(pactl get-sink-volume "$SINK" 2>/dev/null | grep -oP "[0-9]+%" | head -1 | tr -d "%")
    if [ "$MUTE" = "yes" ] || [ "${VOL:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then
        pactl set-sink-mute "$SINK" 0 2>/dev/null
        pactl set-sink-volume "$SINK" 100% 2>/dev/null
        log "sink corrigido: desmutado + 100%"
    fi
    pactl set-sink-port "$SINK" analog-output-lineout 2>/dev/null
    fix_alsa_mixer
}

boot_set_default

while true; do
    if ! has_alc892 && has_autonull; then
        log "auto_null detectado, recuperando ALC892..."
        if recover_module; then
            systemctl --user restart wireplumber 2>/dev/null
            sleep 5
        elif recover_s3_reset; then
            systemctl --user restart wireplumber 2>/dev/null
            sleep 5
        else
            log "recuperacao falhou, retry em 30s"
            sleep 30
            continue
        fi
    fi
    has_alc892 && unmute_if_needed
    sleep 15
done

exit 0

boot_set_default() {
    [ -f "$FLAG_FILE" ] && return
    touch "$FLAG_FILE"
    log "boot: verificando fone Bluetooth..."
    for i in $(seq 1 20); do

    sleep 5

    return 1

has_alc892() { pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "pci-0000_00_1b.0\|ALC892"; }
has_autonull() { pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "auto_null"; }

    fi
    pactl set-sink-port "$SINK" analog-output-lineout 2>/dev/null
    fix_alsa_mixer

    sleep 15
done

1. **Probe do codec falha no slot padrão.** O ALC892 responde apenas com `probe_mask=0x11` (SDIN 0+4). A sonda padrão não o enxerga → `no codecs found`. O watcher antigo só usava `single_cmd=1 enable_msi=0` (insuficiente).
2. **Amp externo (GPIO) desligado após reload do módulo.** O driver reseta `GPIO IO0/IO1` para `enable=0, data=0` a cada `modprobe`. O ALC892 reconhece, mas o amp dos jacks traseiros fica mudo → codec "presente" sem som. O driver não seta GPIO sozinho (sem quirk de placa).

```bash

# 2. Amp liga (hda-verb):

hda-verb /dev/snd/hwC0D0 0x01 SET_GPIO_DIRECTION 0x03
hda-verb /dev/snd/hwC0D0 0x01 SET_GPIO_DATA 0x03        # IO0+IO1 HIGH

hda-verb /dev/snd/hwC0D0 0x1b SET_EAPD_BTLENABLE 0x02   # HP frontal
hda-verb /dev/snd/hwC0D0 0x14 SET_PIN_WIDGET_CONTROL 0x40
```

- `/usr/local/sbin/audio-autorescue.sh` (timer horário) → idem.
